peerGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (CCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

positions.label: Resale activity
positions.statement: Resale activity — Around peers (39.8): 2.5 resales per 100 homes a year (24 months): higher than 157 of 405 similar developments with a figure (the same as 8). Context, not scored: resales in 12.5% of months (24 months).

comparisonGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (CCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

profile.rule: Each line compares this development with its own comparison group; numbers from different groups are not comparable. There is no overall score.
profile.surroundingMarket: Surrounding market: other condo and EC developments within 2 km (straight line between development positions); new sales plus resales; subsales, cluster and other landed housing, HDB flats and this development are excluded. Competition, the quiet-area check and the Market backdrop use this same set.

lines.label: Entry price against comparable developments

missing.reason: too few comparable resales for a price comparison

lines.statement: Not available: too few comparable resales for a price comparison.

lines.label: Sustained resale activity
lines.statement: No first resale wave in the observation period: sustained activity is the observed activity.

lines.label: MRT today
lines.statement: Dover MRT about 740 m, Buona Vista MRT about 1,640 m; closer than 41 of 551 similar developments (the same as 3). Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Primary schools
lines.statement: 1 within 1 km and 4 within 2 km; nearest Henry Park Primary School about 470 m; more than 107 of 551 similar developments (the same as 202). Straight-line distances. MOE measures distance for school admission differently.

lines.label: Everyday amenities
lines.statement: 3 supermarkets within 1 km (nearest about 220 m), more than 73 of 551 similar developments (the same as 47); nearest hawker centre Clementi Ave 2 Market/Cooked Food Centre about 1,140 m; nearest park Rail Corridor about 450 m. Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Future transport
lines.statement: Not yet assessed: needs official LTA evidence for planned stations.

lines.label: Recorded new-launch competition
lines.statement: 6 other condo developments sold new homes within 2 km (Pinetree Hill, 58 new sales, about 490 m; Nava Grove, 77 new sales, about 610 m; Amberwood at Holland, 24 new sales, about 1,380 m; Skye at Holland, 666 new sales, about 1,520 m; Blossoms by the Park, 11 new sales, about 1,820 m; Elta, 81 new sales, about 1,840 m). Surrounding market, Oct 2025–Sep 2026: 57 other condo and EC developments within 2 km recorded 917 new sales and 308 resales (1,225 purchases); new sales were 74.9% of these purchases. Subsales (41) and this development’s own transactions are excluded. New sales as a share of local private purchases is a measure of market activity, not of supply pressure.

lines.label: Unsold inventory

missing.reason: not available until the URA-based launched-unsold measure (S3) passes the V1 local validation; no other inventory source is used

lines.statement: Not available: unsold inventory has not been validated.

lines.label: Known pipeline

missing.reason: known sites only; not a complete pipeline

lines.statement: Within 2 km: Holland Plain GLS site (government land sale site, awarded), about 1,280 m. Known sites only; not a complete pipeline.

lines.label: Quiet-area check
lines.statement: Quiet area: local resales are among the lowest 30% of similar developments, so little nearby competition reflects a thin market, not an advantage. 308 resales within 2 km in Oct 2025–Sep 2026, more than 25 of 551 similar developments.

lines.label: Market backdrop
lines.statement: Condo and EC resales within 2 km: 308 in Oct 2025–Sep 2026 against 335 in Oct 2024–Sep 2025 (−8.1%). Planning-area private resales −4.6%. Observed transactions, not a prediction.
